policy: Files are newly authored unless listed here. The LICENSE asset is imported byte for byte. The host runtime and tests under src/octo, src/host and test/host are selective imports from codex-channel-octo at the listed commit: each entry pins the source blob (git SHA-1) and raw source sha256, the destination sha256 and the only transforms applied. Authored files under those paths are listed as authored. Lint and security exceptions are allowed only for the exact listed line of a listed file at its pinned destination hash; no path-wide skip and no runtime endpoint allowance.
